newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil to offer 36-month dollar-indexed notes.
newsitem.headline: Brazil to offer 36-month dollar-indexed notes.

text.p: Brazil's National Treasury will offer 36-month dollar-indexed notes (NTN-D) at an auction on January 31, Gazeta Mercantil newspaper said on Tuesday.
Currently, the Treasury only offers to the market NTNs with a maximum maturity period of two years, the newspaper said.
Gazeta said the move is aimed at calming the financial markets which fear eventual changes in the country's foreign exchange policy.
But the Treasury Secretary Eduardo Augusto Guimaraes was quoted as saying that the measure is part of the government's policy to stretch the maturity period of the federal public debt.
The newspaper also said the Finance Ministry would announce on Tuesday the amount of three-year dollar-indexed notes it would offer at the auction.
